items.title: Stocks to watch: Tata Steel, ZEEL, Adani Enterprises, IOCL, SBI, Airtel
items.description: Stocks to watch today, Monday: Tata Steel, ZEEL, Adani Enterprises, Indian Oil, SBI, Bharti Airtel, Kalpataru Ltd, Tata Chemicals, Prestige Estates Projects, and more stocks will be in action today.

items.title: Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty indicates positive open; most Asian markets rebound; Brent below $98
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Monday: The GIFT Nifty indicated a positive open for the Nifty50 index. Asian markets were trading higher in early deals

items.title: Angel One flags Nifty hurdle at 25,150; bullish on ITC, SBI, Force Motors
items.description: Stock market outlook: On the upside, 25,150 on the Nifty may act as an intermediate hurdle, followed by resistance near 25,400, says Osho Krishan of Angel One.

items.title: Asian stocks steady as AI, W Asia jitters recede; dollar firm on Fed bets
items.description: MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside ​Japan rose 0.8% after sliding 4.6% last week. Japan's Nikkei index added 2.5% while Korean shares made small gains

items.title: Pharmacy retail stock Entero Healthcare zooms 33% in 1 week; hits new high
items.description: Entero Healthcare Solutions' share price moved higher by 4% to ₹2,095.30, also its new high, bouncing back 7% from its intraday low of ₹1,967 on Monday.

items.title: Data Patterns shares zoom 9% post Q2 show, nearly double from Jan lows
items.description: Data Patterns posted a profit after tax (PAT) of 21.97 crore in Q2 FY27 as against 49.19 crore in Q2 FY26, a reduction of 55.3 per cent year-on-year (YoY).

items.title: Nvidia's shares slide as chip giant probes CEO Huang over spy claims
items.description: Nvidia's shares tumbled more than 6% in Frankfurt trading, extending last ​week's selloff and pushing the stock to fresh multi-month lows

items.title: IRB Infra share price climbs 7% as toll collections boost Q2 earnings
items.description: IRB Infra share price target: MOFSL has retained its earnings estimates and reiterated a 'Buy' rating on IRB Infra stock, with a target price of ₹22.

items.title: Ashok Leyland, Paytm down after 6-day rally; analyst flags positive charts
items.description: Ashok Leyland and Paytm were down up to 3% in Friday's intraday trades, having rallied up to 23% in the preceding six trading sessions.

items.title: Uno Minda zooms 26% in November, stock nears record high; here's why
items.description: Uno Minda's share price hit a 52-week high of ₹1,367.50, gaining 4% on the NSE in Monday's intraday deals.

items.title: PVR Inox rises 3% to 52-wk high as Ramayana's box-office biz tops ₹500 cr
items.description: Notably, the Ranbir Kapoor-Sai Pallavi starrer 'Ramayana: Part One', which was released on November 5, today entered the ₹500 club, according to data provided by Sacnilk.

items.title: ZEEL extends gains, rises 11% in 2 days as board to mull buyback, dividend
items.description: ZEEL settled with a bullish reversal candlestick pattern on its weekly charts, signalling a potential relief rally toward the 80 mark in the near term, show tech charts.

items.title: Pharma shares shine: Sai, Gland, Divi's, Laurus, Glenmark surge up to 9%
items.description: Divi's Labs, Laurus Labs, Sai Life Sciences and Glenmark Pharma quoted at their respective record highs in Monday's trade.

items.title: Multibagger stock: Sai Life Sciences surges 9% to record high after Q2 nos
items.description: Sai Life Sciences' consolidated net profit increased by 17 per cent Y-o-Y to ₹98 crore in the September quarter of FY27. Its revenue grew by 23 per cent Y-o-Y to ₹659 crore.

items.title: Jubilant FoodWorks dips 5% post Q2, but brokerages remain firm; here's why
items.description: MOFSL said it remains positive on Jubilant Food's medium-term outlook, supported by 5-7 per cent LFL growth potential, strong Popeyes momentum, and healthy international performance.

items.title: PSU Banks in focus; SBI, BOI, PNB, Indian Bank, Canara, UBI gain up to 3%
items.description: The Nifty PSU Bank index was the top gainer among sectoral indices up 2% in Monday's intraday deals, while the Nifty slipped 0.3%.

items.title: Voltas dips 8% in two sessions post Q2 earnings; Emkay retains 'Buy' rating
items.description: Analysts at Emkay retained 'Buy' rating on Voltas with a target price of ₹1,500 as valuations remain attractive and the stock trades near the lower end of the historical range.

items.title: Divis joins ₹3 trn market cap club; rallies 15% in 2 days post Q2 results
items.description: The stock price of Divi's Labs quoted higher for the 12th straight trading day, surging 32 per cent during the period.

items.title: Tata Steel dips 1.5% after 5-day rally; brokerages stay upbeat on India biz
items.description: Tata Steel has posted a more than 16 per cent Y-o-Y rise in consolidated net profit to ₹3,700 crore in the September quarter, driven by higher revenues, mainly from India operations.

items.title: Honasa Consumer gains 5% as brokerages raise target, earnings post Q2
items.description: In 2026 so far, Honasa shares have climbed 70 per cent and are up 76 per cent on a one-year basis, according to NSE data.

items.title: Why FPIs turned aggressive buyers in November? Choice Wealth explains
items.description: Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) net bought stocks worth ₹38,971 crore in the first week of November as against net sales of ₹34,843 crore in October, flags analyst at Choice Wealth.
